Subject: Marketplace reseller addendum — pass-through clauses

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is putting together the final order form and needs one item clarified before we can route to legal: Cloud marketplace billing needs to be explicitly pass-through, and our finance team requires an evidence package that ties invoiced charges to marketplace-metered usage (invoice lineage, sample S3 export, and a seller-signed attestation).

Can Redwood confirm this for the seller addendum and share a short checklist of the evidence you can provide? We want to avoid a long redline cycle — if you can provide a template attestation + where the meter exports live, that would speed approvals up.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudFlux Inc.

Thanks Sarah — looping in Partnerships (Marissa) and Sales Ops (Ben copied below) to assemble the evidence package.

Quick answers:
- We support pass-through billing for marketplace transactions and can sign the seller attestation you need.
- Meter exports are available via our billing endpoint (we can provide S3 export + one sample CSV for the first month).

I’ll aim to get a checklist and redline proposals back by Friday.

From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudFlux reseller pass-through redline — initial legal notes

Dylan / Marissa — forwarding initial legal notes after reviewing CloudFlux's high-level ask. Key points for drafting redline: 

1) Pass-through invoicing: we can accommodate language that invoices are routed through the marketplace and that marketplace fees are itemized. Need to preserve Redwood's right to collect amounts due directly if marketplace fails to remit (limited by timeframe & notice).
2) Attestation: we can provide a seller-signed attestation that the invoices correspond to usage reports; however, the attestation should be narrow: confirm availability of exports and accuracy to best of our knowledge rather than unlimited warranty.
3) Evidence package: propose a standard checklist (see attached) — includes: sample exported CSV (billing.csv), S3 path + IAM read instructions, description of billing metrics, and a signed attestation PDF. Some customers will ask for additional audit logs; we should push back on broad log disclosure (provide sanitized reports instead).

I'll draft redline language for the addendum and an evidence checklist. Drafts attached — please review and flag any commercial asks we should elevate.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace reseller addendum — pass-through clauses

Hi Sarah — attaching the Redwood checklist and a proposed attestation template. Short summary for Procurement:

- What we will provide: signed attestation (seller-signed PDF), one month of raw billing CSV export (S3 link + read IAM), mapping doc explaining columns and metering keys, and a short statement of how marketplace fees are calculated.
- What we cannot provide: full system logs or internal PII; if you need additional audit-level logs we can offer a sanitized ledger sample or a joint attestation process with your audit team.
- Proposed redline: we add a clause that allows CloudFlux to request up to two evidence deliveries per 12-month period with 30 days' notice. Anything beyond that requires an agreed SOW and cost recovery.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm that the above satisfies Procurement.
2) If yes, I’ll upload the sample CSV to a secure S3 link and share the attestation PDF for signature.

Thanks — cc'ing Ben for billing sequencing and DocuSign routing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

Sarah — quick operational note on sequencing to avoid double-billing:

- We will generate the sample billing export and upload it to an S3 bucket with a short-lived presigned URL. That URL will be shared in parallel with the attestation for signature.
- For the addendum redline (Marissa's draft), we recommend including: invoice delivery procedure, contact for billing disputes, and an explicit fallback where Redwood may invoice CloudFlux directly if marketplace settlement is delayed >60 days.
- DocuSign routing: once legal signs, Redwood will send the attestation via DocuSign to the CloudFlux signatory (Sarah or Alex).

If Procurement confirms the 2 requests / 12 months limit, we can finalize and push to signature today.
